[{"insert":"Sumo Deadlift

The sumo deadlift is your main pull on Fridays. The wide stance with your hands gripping inside your knees shortens the pull and shifts more of the work onto your hips and inner thighs. Set your back flat, keep your chest up, and drive your feet apart into the floor as the bar comes up. Reps drop across the odd weeks, so the weight climbs each time it comes back.
"}]
